name: selected effect classifier (per-effect role)
semantic_facts: every exact effect of one (entry,rank) is classified from kind, aura subtype, misc0 operation, misc1 selector/label, class mask, shell (period 0, AP/SP 0, neutral amount facts, neutral chain, targets (1,0), mechanic 0, radius 0, no effect attributes, trigger only on inert-listed subtypes) and the selected rank amount
roles: SpellModifier(Percent Direct/Periodic/CriticalBonus/Cooldown x ClassMask/Label, FlatFirstEffect, PercentFirstEffect, FlatCooldown) + 11 passive roles
source position never selects a role (probe a_package_contract.rs::holds_source_order_does_not_determine_role)

name: selected composition gate (role multiset admission)
semantic_facts: arity 1 always admitted; arity>=2 admitted only for reviewed multisets over 10 slot roles; any role outside the 10 slots counts as other and rejects multi-effect packages
every admitted multi-effect multiset contains >=1 SpellModifier role

name: shared selected owner policy
semantic_facts: neutral owner (defense None, dispel none, empty owner class mask, no mechanics); identity-matched external policy all Absent; inert AuraOptions; no equipment; zero missile; unconditional passive; only Passive + Ignored (+416 with Passive) attributes
owner-role count == package arity and every role PassiveModifier (counted over all selected ownerships of the owner spell)

name: cold package provenance recorder and lookup
semantic_facts: records (entry,rank,effect) for packages with >=2 effects only, supplied by the spell-modifier compiler; sorted by (entry,rank,effect)
selected_passive_package_source returns the first exact-effect match; selected_passive_package_effects filters by exact source

name: complete sibling declaration check
semantic_facts: each role checks the exact effect in its own ordinary catalog family with activation/selected_trait == exact (entry,rank); raw 638 additionally requires Multiplicative composition

name: state-construction package binding validator (5-family iterator)
semantic_facts: runs before any runtime owner compiles; for every bound (actor,effect) of a recorded package requires each member (actor,member) exactly once across the chained families
families: spell-modifier, critical-block, passive auto-attack damage, passive critical, passive healing received; binding family identity is not retained (CSA-A-01)

name: passive spell-property modifier compiler (selected path)
semantic_facts: selected value = package role value (selected rank); sibling declarations; shared owner policy + owner-role count; provenance recorded for arity>=2

name: passive auto-attack damage compiler
semantic_facts: requires package role AutoAttackDamage == declared effect and a Direct Percent SpellModifier sibling; selected rank amount -> binary32 factor 1+f32(p)/100; shared owner policy

name: passive healing received compiler
semantic_facts: SelectedTraitPassive activation only; selected rank amount finite > 0; shared owner policy

name: passive all-haste compiler (selected path)
semantic_facts: at most one definition; selected rank amount; shared owner policy; non-selected path pinned to carrier 28830#1 (5%)

name: passive melee auto-attack-speed compiler
semantic_facts: exactly one selected definition; selected rank amount -> binary32 period factor 100/(100+p); shared owner policy

name: passive school damage (done/taken) compiler
semantic_facts: direction from package role (DamageDone -> OutgoingHolder, DamageTaken -> IncomingHolder); school from misc0; selected rank amount; shared owner policy

name: passive absorb received compiler
semantic_facts: selected rank amount -> factor 1+p/100 (f64); shared owner policy

name: passive modifier plan container
semantic_facts: owns the spell-modifier child plan that carries selected_package_effects; constructed whenever any passive child exists (modifier.rs:911-917)

name: selected owner role counter (action owners)
semantic_facts: counts CastAction/Program/AuraDefinition/Modifier/Driver roles of an owner spell; any other role (incl. PassiveModifier) returns None - used by action-owned selected paths, not by passive packages

name: exact-source shared facts
semantic_facts: stable selected-trait error facts; exact neutral aura source contract uses authored base points for fixed carriers (never for selected amounts)

name: critical-block amount compiler (selected path)
semantic_facts: selected rank amount stored (09d4fdab fix holds); no shared owner policy (CSA-A-02); private owner-attribute check (CSA-A-03)

name: critical-chance compiler (selected path)
semantic_facts: expected role from subtype (raw 334 ModAutoAttackCritChance, ModAllCritChance, CritChanceForCasterWithAbilities); selected rank amount; shared owner policy; composition host-supplied (UNK-A-001)

name: selected trait source resolution
semantic_facts: identity match; max ranks 1|2; non-override non-subtree definitions; complete effect set (source_effect_count == retained); point rows 0 (rank 1) / >=1 (rank 2), op 0 Set / 1 Multiply else reject, one row per effect, exact integer-rank curve points; unpointed effects keep authored

name: selected spell ownership stream
semantic_facts: duplicate occurrences retained; all selected passive families map to PassiveModifier

name: engine selected-trait candidates
semantic_facts: classify with the same contract, publish declarations + Player bindings atomically, refuse existing declaration/binding; output is untrusted and fully revalidated by CombatProgram and state construction
